Name: Custom Profit Margin
Author: NimbleArkady
Description:
[b][size=4][u]Description[/u][/size][/b]
This mod allows you to customize the selling price of items by adjusting a profit margin multiplier. You can configure the multiplier via the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) to increase or decrease the gold you receive when selling items.
For example, setting the multiplier to 2.00 will double your selling prices. The default multiplier is set to 2.00. This modifier strictly applies only to the items you sell; it does not affect or change the purchase prices of items in any shops.

[size=4][b][u]Installation instructions[/u][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the .zip file.[/*]
[*]Place the extracted CustomProfitMargin folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4][u]Main features[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Adjust the selling price of items using a custom multiplier (e.g., 0.50 for half price, 2.00 for double price). The default value is 2.00.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/b] [/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] [/*]
[/list]
